entities.name: Irie
entities.description: A young human apprentice to Muzzio at the High City of Paliano on Fiora.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Artificer in Paliano who builds constructs that record conversations, hoping to guide Fiora's society.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: City on Fiora with a High City and Low City.

entities.name: Academy of Paliano
entities.description: Academy Irie could not afford to enter and whose Chancellor vote Muzzio failed.

entities.name: High Paliano Board of Senior Advisors
entities.description: Body that voted on the Chancellor of the Academy.

entities.name: Grand Library
entities.description: Library from which Irie retrieved parts and books.

events.summary: Muzzio takes on Irie as his apprentice since Irie could not afford the academy.
events.quote: Muzzio had seen the potential in him and brought him on as his apprentice

events.summary: Muzzio fails to secure the vote to become Chancellor and summons Irie.
participants: High Paliano Board of Senior Advisors
events.quote: Muzzio had failed to secure the vote to become Chancellor of the Academy

events.summary: Muzzio shows Irie the secret lower workshop with more than a hundred constructs and a scale model of Paliano.
events.quote: more than a hundred mechanical constructs stood in rows

events.summary: Muzzio asks whether Irie thinks he has killed anyone and denies ever having done so.
events.quote: Muzzio denied having ever killed anyone

events.summary: Muzzio explains his constructs record what they hear onto wax cylinders to gather information.
events.quote: every construct in Paliano is either built with or from Muzzio's designs

events.summary: Muzzio tells Irie he hopes Fiora could become like places that blend machine perfection with organic life.
events.quote: Muzzio hoped Fiora one day could be like those places

relations.quote: Irie is the young human apprentice to Muzzio
every construct in Paliano is either built with or from Muzzio's designs
